recording.title: Browsing records
recording.description: Counts page visits and only tracks time on the active tab of the focused window.

privacy.title: Local and private
privacy.description:
Stores only site domains, times, and visit counts — never page content, titles, or full URLs.
Ignores incognito windows and internal browser pages, and never sends data to a server.
You can delete one site or one day. That removes those records from this device.

method.title: How it's measured
method.description:
Each page load or reload counts as one visit; switching tabs or in-app navigation in single-page apps doesn't add visits.
{{idle}} seconds without system input counts as idle; progress is saved every {{checkpoint}} seconds.
Keeps visits and active sessions for {{days}} days; daily and hourly totals stay until you clear them or delete that site or day.
method.audible: A tab playing unmuted sound isn't counted as idle.

audible.title: Keep counting while audio plays
audible.description: If the active tab in the focused window is playing unmuted sound, idle time still counts. Timing stops as soon as the sound stops or the tab is muted.

idle.title: Idle threshold
idle.description: How long without keyboard or mouse input before this browser counts as idle.
idle.label: Idle threshold: {{duration}}

siteMerge.title: Group subdomains
siteMerge.description: Changes how the overview and site details are grouped. Saved records keep the original hostname, and you can switch at any time.
siteMerge.label: Subdomain grouping: {{mode}}

recordMode.title: Recording scope
recordMode.description: Choose which sites are timed from now on. The blacklist and the whitelist are stored separately. Switching mode does not clear the other list, and it does not delete or hide existing records. example.com matches that host and its subdomains; mail.example.com does not match example.com.
recordMode.blacklistHint: Record every site except the ones listed below.
recordMode.whitelistHint: Record only the sites listed below.

ignored.title: Ignored sites
ignored.description: These hosts and their subdomains are not timed and visits are not counted, the same as an internal browser page. example.com also matches a.example.com; mail.example.com does not match example.com. Existing records stay in the ledger and are not hidden.
ignored.emptyDescription: Add a host to stop recording it from now on.
ignored.error: Enter a host such as example.com. The protocol, path, and port are removed. Spaces are not allowed, and a name without a dot is only accepted for localhost.
ignored.limit: You can ignore up to {{count}} hosts.

allowed.title: Allowed sites
allowed.description: Only these hosts and their subdomains are timed and counted as visits. example.com also matches a.example.com; mail.example.com does not match example.com. Existing records stay in the ledger and are not hidden.
allowed.emptyDescription: Add a host to record it from now on. Until you do, nothing is recorded.
allowed.limit: You can allow up to {{count}} hosts.
allowed.emptyWarning: No hosts are allowed, so PageTime will not record time or visits for any site. An empty list does not mean record every site. Add at least one host before anything is recorded. Existing records stay and are not hidden.
allowed.error: Enter a host such as example.com. The protocol, path, and port are removed. Spaces are not allowed, and a name without a dot is only accepted for localhost.

howItWorks.title: How PageTime counts time
howItWorks.intro: PageTime only counts time you actually spend looking at a page. The rules are below.

counted.title: What counts
counted.focus: The selected tab in a focused foreground window
counted.web: Only http and https pages, totaled by domain
counted.navigation: When the same tab navigates to another site, time on the new site starts at that navigation

notCounted.title: What doesn't count
notCounted.idle_one: {{count}} second in a row without keyboard or mouse input (including watching video or listening to audio)
notCounted.idle_other: {{count}} seconds in a row without keyboard or mouse input (including watching video or listening to audio)
notCounted.locked: While the screen is locked, the computer is asleep, or the browser is closed
notCounted.unfocused: A minimized window, another app in front, or focused DevTools
notCounted.internal: Browser internal pages, extension pages, and local files
notCounted.gap_one: When checks are more than {{count}} second apart, at most {{count}} second of that gap is counted (for example, while the system is suspended)
notCounted.gap_other: When checks are more than {{count}} seconds apart, at most {{count}} seconds of that gap are counted (for example, while the system is suspended)
notCounted.ignored: Blacklist mode: sites you chose to ignore ({{count}}), and their subdomains, are not timed or counted as visits. An entry of example.com matches that host and every subdomain; an entry of mail.example.com does not match example.com. Existing records are not deleted or hidden.
notCounted.whitelist: Whitelist mode: only allowed sites ({{count}}) and their subdomains are timed and counted as visits. An empty list records nothing. An entry of example.com matches that host and every subdomain; an entry of mail.example.com does not match example.com. Existing records are not deleted or hidden.

visits.title: How visits are counted
visits.description: A page load or reload counts as 1 visit. Switching tabs and in-app navigation in single-page apps do not.

privacy.title: Privacy and storage
privacy.fields: Only the domain, times, and visit counts are saved — never the title, page text, or full URL.
privacy.local: Data stays in this browser on this device and is never uploaded to a server.
privacy.delete: You can delete one site or one day. Those records are removed from this device's database and can't be undone.
privacy.retention_one: Keeps visit records and time spans for the last {{count}} day. Daily and hourly totals stay until you clear them or delete that site or day.
privacy.retention_other: Keeps visit records and time spans for the last {{count}} days. Daily and hourly totals stay until you clear them or delete that site or day.
privacy.save_one: Saves every {{count}} second. If the browser closes unexpectedly, at most that recent interval can be lost.
privacy.save_other: Saves every {{count}} seconds. If the browser closes unexpectedly, at most that recent interval can be lost.

limits.title: Known limits
limits.audible: The browser can take 2–3 seconds to notice that sound started or stopped.
limits.threshold: With a 10-minute idle threshold, up to 10 extra minutes can be counted after you leave.

merge.title: How sites are grouped
merge.storage: Records keep the original hostname. Grouping only changes what the overview shows; it never rewrites saved rows, and you can turn it off.
merge.none: Don't group: each hostname is counted on its own.
merge.prefix: Common prefixes: a leading www., m., or mobile. is removed. www.youtube.com and m.youtube.com become youtube.com. Other names, such as gist.github.com, stay separate.
merge.registrable: Registrable domain: grouped with the ICANN section of the Public Suffix List. a.b.example.co.uk becomes example.co.uk. IP addresses, localhost, and hosts with no registrable domain stay unchanged. Private suffixes such as github.io are not treated as public suffixes, so user.github.io is grouped under github.io.
